description: Helps you decide which questions expose the gaps in your main competitor, without negative selling. You give the named competitor, your solution, your strengths and its weak points as you know them. You get the set up, discovery questions, criteria to establish, reference call questions, requirement and scenario traps, commercial terms and tactics for your stage, with sector notes. Every line comes from your inputs and the sector, and none from an invented fact about the competitor. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of competitive_intel when you need discovery questions and evaluation criteria for one competitor.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

buyer_persona.description: Role of key evaluator. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

buyer_priorities.description: What the buyer cares most about. Format is text. For example, "renewal decision depends on a documented approval process".

competitor.description: Primary competitor to position against. Format is text. For example, "the current manual review process".

competitor_weaknesses.description: Known competitor weaknesses. Format is text. For example, "handoffs require manual reconciliation".

evaluation_stage.description: Stage of competitive evaluation. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "early".

trap_type.description: Type of competitive positioning. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "discovery_questions".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: Your product/solution. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

your_strengths.description: Your key differentiators. Format is text. For example, "checks invoice exceptions before approval".

title: Competitive Trap Setter
